payload.name: Airtasker
payload.description: 发布任务并聘请服务人员
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Airtasker app brings Customers and Taskers together, making it easier to get things done or find your next job, all within ChatGPT. From cleaning, removals and furniture assembly to gardening, deliveries and odd jobs - if you need a hand, there’s a Tasker for that.

payload.name: Tomorrow.io Weather
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tomorrow.io Weather lets you explore weather conditions and air quality for locations around the world through natural conversation.
You can ask questions like when the weather may be more comfortable to visit a city, how conditions compare across multiple locations, or whether air quality is currently good in a specific area. The app presents weather forecasts and air quality information clearly, making it easy to explore conditions by day or location.
Tomorrow.io is the company behind a broader weather intelligence platform that combines a proprietary constellation of satellites, advanced AI models, and operational weather workflows to help organizations understand and apply weather information at scale. This app is designed for exploration and informational use.
payload.longDescription:
Tomorrow.io Weather 让你可以通过自然对话了解全球各地的天气状况和空气质量。
你可以询问何时前往某座城市天气更舒适、多个地点的状况有何不同，或某个特定区域当前的空气质量是否良好。此应用会清晰呈现天气预报和空气质量信息，便于按日期或地点探索天气状况。

Everything your favorite kitchen management app does, and more, inside ChatGPT.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer. It stores your recipes, plans your meals, builds your shopping lists, and tracks the nutrition behind it all, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week

**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

payload.name: Drums kit- Learn+improve w AI!

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score? Ask for one. Want a detailed breakdown? Ask for that instead. Want tips that are easy enough for a child to follow? ChatGPT can do that. Want advice that feels more like a drum teacher? It can change its style to match your goals. You control the conversation.

The app is also great for small challenges. See if you can keep a steady beat for one minute. Try playing softer or louder. Practice using only one hand. Build a simple groove and slowly make it more interesting. After each try, ChatGPT can explain what changed and suggest the next challenge. Little wins add up, and every new rhythm gives you something to learn from.

This creates a different kind of music experience inside ChatGPT. Instead of only talking about drumming, you can actually drum. Instead of getting general advice, you receive feedback tied to your own performance. Instead of stopping to move between tools, everything stays together in one place. The result is a playful way to practice, learn, experiment, and improve. Whether you have never held a pair of sticks, already play every week, or just want to tap out a fun beat for a few minutes, the app turns a conversation into an interactive practice space where every hit can become a chance to learn.
payload.longDescription:

Roughly 80% of civil litigants in the United States appear without legal representation. Without guidance, they lose cases on procedural technicalities before the merits are ever heard.

The Courtroom5 app gives ChatGPT users access to three jurisdiction-aware legal tools: a case intake assessment that evaluates a user's situation and identifies applicable civil claims; a deadline calculator that returns precise procedural deadlines and consequences by state and court level; and next-step guidance for users already in active litigation. All tools are scoped to civil matters in US state and federal courts and designed for plain-language delivery to non-lawyers.

Courtroom5 is a Techstars graduate and recipient of the ABA Woman of Legal Tech recognition. We have served over 12,000 self-represented litigants across all 50 states.

Courtroom5 应用为 ChatGPT 用户提供三种了解司法管辖区的法律工具：评估用户情况并识别适用民事诉求的案件受理评估；按州和法院级别提供精确程序期限及其后果的截止日期计算器；以及为已进入诉讼程序的用户提供后续步骤指导。所有工具仅适用于美国州法院和联邦法院的民事案件，并以通俗易懂的语言面向非律师设计。

Courtroom5 是 Techstars 毕业企业，并获得 ABA Woman of Legal Tech 认可。我们已在全部 50 个州为超过 12,000 名自行代理的诉讼当事人提供服务。

payload.name: Real Random
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Real Random lets people generate a random number, pick one or more items from a list, and shuffle a list inside ChatGPT. It is useful for giveaways, team rotation, classroom activities, and everyday decisions.

Practical ways to use Real Random App:
1. Pick entertainment: Choose movies, TV shows, or books when you can't decide.
2. Raffles & giveaways: Draw one or many winners from participant.
3. Everyday decisions: Randomly pick meals, chores, meeting order, or any list-based choice.
payload.longDescription:
Real Random 可让用户在 ChatGPT 中生成随机数、从列表中选出一个或多个项目，以及打乱列表顺序。适用于抽奖、团队轮换、课堂活动和日常决策。

Real Random 应用的实用场景：
1. 选择娱乐内容：犹豫不决时，从电影、电视节目或书籍中随机挑选。
2. 抽签与赠礼：从参与者中抽出一位或多位获奖者。

payload.name: Square Yards
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and explore real estate across India with Square Yards.
                                                                                                    
  Square Yards gives you conversational access to one of India's largest property databases. Search
  new construction projects, rental apartments, and resale properties across major cities, all     
  through natural conversation.                                                                     
                                                                                                    
  Find new projects: Browse new-construction developments with filters for city, budget, unit type,
  developer, and project status. Dive into any project to see pricing, floor plans, amenities, and
  unit configurations.                                                                              
                  
  Search rentals: Explore rental listings filtered by city, rent range, BHK type, furnishing       
  status, and amenities. Get full details on any listing including images and pricing.
                                                                                                    
  Browse resale properties: Discover resale and second-hand listings with filters for city, price  
  range, unit type, and amenities. View complete property details for any listing that catches your

payload.longDescription:
使用 Square Yards 搜索并探索印度各地的房地产。

Square Yards 让你通过对话访问印度规模最大的房产数据库之一。只需自然交流，即可搜索各大城市的新建项目、出租公寓和转售房产。

查找新项目：使用城市、预算、户型、开发商和项目状态等筛选条件浏览新建楼盘。深入查看任一项目的价格、户型图、配套设施和房屋配置。

浏览转售房产：按城市、价格范围、户型和配套设施筛选转售及二手房源。查看任何感兴趣房源的完整房产详情。

搜索结果以互动房产卡片呈现，包含图片、价格和指向 Square Yards 的直接链接。无论你是要购买第一套住房、寻找出租房，还是探索投资机会，Square Yards 都能通过对话帮助你作出明智的房产决策。

payload.name: Lifestyle Helper
payload.description: 值得信赖的日常生活建议
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lifestyle Helper improves ChatGPT answers to everyday life questions by adding reliable, up-to-date, source-backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about cooking, travel, entertainment, education, or psychology, the app enriches responses with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally without external references.

Lifestyle Helper does not collect personal data and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based only on the user’s intentions.
payload.longDescription:
Lifestyle Helper 通过补充来自可信专家资料的可靠、最新且有来源支持的背景信息，改进 ChatGPT 对日常生活问题的回答。

当用户询问烹饪、旅行、娱乐、教育或心理学问题时，该应用会补充相关示例和现实见解作为参考。只有在能明确提升实用性时才会添加背景信息。如果没有找到相关来源，ChatGPT 会像往常一样直接回答，不附带外部参考。

Lifestyle Helper 不收集个人数据，也不提供专业法律或财务建议。只有在符合用户意图时才会推荐外部服务。

payload.name: Fresha
payload.description: 预约本地美容与护理服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and book beauty, grooming, and wellness appointments with Fresha on ChatGPT.

- Discover salons, barbers, spas, medspas, and wellness studios near you.
- Search by service, location, date, time, price, and amenities.
- Found the right appointment? Tap “View on Fresha” to book directly with Fresha.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 Fresha 查找并预约美容、理容和健康护理服务。

- 按服务、地点、日期、时间、价格和设施搜索。
- 找到合适的预约后，点击“在 Fresha 中查看”，直接通过 Fresha 预订。

payload.name: Bayut
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bayut is the easiest way to find your real home in the UAE.

Bayut connects you to a vast database of properties in the UAE, helping you find the perfect option, be it a villa, apartment, office, townhouse or shop - whether for sale or for rent. Easily search for listings using location, property type, bedroom count, price, area, and much more.

Search our listings by asking things like:
- Show me 2-bedroom apartments in Dubai Marina
- Find villas with a jacuzzi under AED 5 million
- Show me penthouses in Dubai over 1,600 sqft
payload.longDescription:
Bayut是在阿联酋找到真正适合你的家的最简单方式。

Bayut让你访问庞大的阿联酋房产数据库，帮助你找到理想选项，无论是别墅、公寓、办公室、联排住宅还是商铺，也无论出售还是出租。按地点、房产类型、卧室数量、价格、面积等轻松搜索房源。

你可以这样询问来搜索房源：
- 显示Dubai Marina的2卧室公寓
- 查找价格低于AED 5百万且带按摩浴缸的别墅

payload.name: foodpanda
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
foodpanda lets users discover nearby food delivery restaurants, search for vendors and dishes, and browse full menus with prices, ratings, delivery estimates, and active promotions. Each result includes deep links so the user can continue to order in the foodpanda app or website. Results render in interactive vendor and menu card widgets.

payload.longDescription:
foodpanda 帮助用户发现附近的外卖餐厅、搜索商家和菜品，并浏览完整菜单，包括价格、评分、配送时间估算和有效促销。每条结果都包含深层链接，方便用户继续在 foodpanda 应用或网站上点餐。结果以交互式商家和菜单卡片呈现。

目前仅在新加坡（SG）提供服务，其他国家和地区即将开放。

payload.name: Background Changer

payload.name: AutoTrader
payload.description: 汽车、摩托车及船艇交易
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AutoTrader – Canada’s Most Trusted Marketplace to Buy and Sell Cars, Trucks, Boats & More!

Looking to buy or sell a vehicle in Canada? With AutoTrader, you get access to the largest inventory of new and used cars nationwide — from Fords and Toyotas to motorcycles, boats, and RVs. payload.name: Tessie

payload.name: BuyWise
payload.description: 找到最佳价格和真实评价
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BuyWise is a shopping assistant for comparing physical consumer products in ChatGPT. Tell BuyWise what you are looking for, including your budget, use case, preferred features, and constraints, and it helps compare relevant products from supported merchants.

BuyWise 是 ChatGPT 中用于比较实体消费品的购物助手。告诉 BuyWise 您要找什么，包括预算、使用场景、偏好功能和限制条件，它会帮助您比较支持商户的相关产品。

payload.name: Apartment List
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Apartment List brings real apartments for rent into your ChatGPT conversation.
Describe what you’re looking for — budget, commute, pets, amenities, move-in timing — and explore available rentals with up-to-date pricing, availability, and fees.

Match, Don’t Just Search: Tell us about your life. We translate it into personalized apartment matches.

Powered by Real Rental Data: Get structured, live inventory — not generic AI responses.

The Anti-Scroll: Compare apartments side by side and ask follow-up questions without leaving chat.

Stop searching. Start finding an apartment you’ll love.

Try asking:
- “Find apartments for rent under $2,300 that allow my 50lb dog.”
- “Show me current rent and availability for this apt.”
- “Compare these rentals by price and pet policies.”
payload.longDescription:
Apartment List 将真实的出租公寓带入你的 ChatGPT 对话。
描述你的需求——预算、通勤、宠物、设施、入住时间——并浏览包含最新价格、空房情况和费用的出租房源。

停止盲目搜索，开始找到你会喜欢的公寓。

试着问：
- “查找租金低于 $2,300、允许我带 50lb 狗入住的公寓。”
- “显示这套公寓当前的租金和空房情况。”
- “按价格和宠物政策比较这些出租房源。”

快速轻松地查找犬种信息并比较犬种。

payload.name: Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
"Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check" helps you review contracts and spot common red flags before signing. Get a clear, card-based overview with risk flags and concise notes on key clauses. Click any card to ask ChatGPT for a deeper explanation.

How it works:
The app contains a checklist of common issues for different contract types:
- Lease
- Employment
- Freelance
- General agreements
The app instructs ChatGPT to assess your agreement through the checklist tailored to your contract type. Results of the review are presented as clickable "Ok" / "Warning" / "High-Risk" cards.

Disclaimers:
- Use this app as an extra set of eyes - not a replacement for legal advice.
- Get a lawyer’s review for high-value, high-risk, or unfamiliar terms.
- Read the full contract and make sure you understand it before signing.

Not legal advice. The developer of "Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check" is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. No attorney-client relationship is created. Outputs are AI-generated and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated. Use it for informational purposes only and consult a qualified attorney for legal advice before signing. Do not use this app for criminal law matters, immigration matters, or family law disputes.
payload.longDescription:
“Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check”可帮助你在签署前审阅合同并发现常见风险。通过清晰的卡片概览查看风险标记和关键条款简要说明。点击任一卡片，即可向 ChatGPT 询问更深入的解释。

工作方式：
此应用包含针对不同合同类型的常见问题清单：
- 租赁
- 雇佣
- 自由职业
- 一般协议
应用会指导 ChatGPT 根据适用于相应合同类型的清单评估你的协议。审阅结果以可点击的“正常”/“警告”/“高风险”卡片呈现。

免责声明：
- 将此应用作为额外的审阅视角，而非法律意见的替代品。
- 对于高价值、高风险或不熟悉的条款，请让律师审阅。
- 签署前请阅读完整合同并确保理解其内容。

这不是法律意见。“Safe2Sign: Contract Risk Check”的开发者不是律师事务所，也不提供法律意见。不会建立律师与客户关系。输出由 AI 生成，可能不准确、不完整或已过时。仅将其用于信息参考；签署前请咨询具备资格的律师以获取法律意见。请勿将此应用用于刑事法律、移民事务或家庭法律纠纷。

payload.name: Unni

payload.name: CarMax
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore a new, personalized way to shop for cars or sell your current one, all within ChatGPT. Try asking things like: 

- Can you help me narrow my search for SUVs with good gas mileage? 
- What’s the market value for a 2018 Honda Civic with 80k miles? 
- Can you give me an offer on my car? 

Instead of switching between tabs or browsing multiple sites, CarMax for ChatGPT helps you get real offers, explore today’s inventory, and understand every step of buying or selling a car—all in one natural, easy conversation. It’s the simplest way to shop or sell, no matter where you are in your car‑buying journey.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中探索一种全新、个性化的买车或出售现有车辆方式。您可以询问：

- 能帮我缩小省油 SUV 的搜索范围吗？
- 里程 80,000 英里的 2018 款本田思域市场价值是多少？
- 能为我的车报价吗？

CarMax for ChatGPT 让您无需切换标签页或浏览多个网站，即可获得真实报价、探索今日库存，并了解买卖车辆的每个步骤——全部通过自然轻松的对话完成。无论您处于购车流程的哪个阶段，买车或卖车都很简单。

payload.name: ASOS Stylist
payload.description: 选购数百个品牌的商品
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meet the ASOS Stylist for ChatGPT: a visual way to shop fashion in conversation. Ask for a look, see how the pieces come together, and fine‑tune by fit, budget and aesthetic. Fast, visual and tailored to your vibe - without the guesswork.
payload.longDescription: 认识面向 ChatGPT 的 ASOS Stylist：在对话中以可视化方式选购时尚服饰。提出穿搭需求，查看各单品如何组合，并按合身程度、预算和审美微调。快速、直观、贴合你的风格，无需凭空猜测。

payload.name: Wellness Coach
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Wellness Coach provides instant access to a curated library of expert-led wellness content covering mental health, emotional wellbeing, physical health, mindfulness, stress management, sleep, nutrition, and personal growth.

Use Wellness Coach when you want trusted, structured wellness content — including stress relief sessions, anxiety support, mindfulness practices, sleep guidance, and personal growth programs — delivered by experienced instructors.

The app searches a highly rated on-demand content library and surfaces the most relevant wellness videos based on your question, helping you move from concern to action with practical guidance.
payload.longDescription:
Wellness Coach 可即时访问精心策划的专家指导健康内容库，涵盖心理健康、情绪健康、身体健康、正念、压力管理、睡眠、营养和个人成长。

当你需要可信且结构化的健康内容时，可以使用 Wellness Coach。内容包括缓解压力练习、焦虑支持、正念练习、睡眠指导和个人成长计划，并由经验丰富的指导者提供。

该应用会搜索评价较高的按需内容库，并根据你的问题展示最相关的健康视频，帮助你从担忧转向行动，获得实用指导。

payload.name: Photographer Finder by HB
payload.description: 查找并预约 HoneyBook 摄影师
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ready to find the right photographer? HoneyBook's Photographers Directory makes it easy.

Whether you're planning a wedding, engagement, birthday party, corporate event, or special celebration, simply describe what you're looking for, such as "wedding photographers in Brooklyn" or "engagement photographers near Denver," and discover trusted photography vendors in your area. Browse personalized matches, explore their work, and inquire directly through HoneyBook to connect with the perfect photographer in minutes.
payload.longDescription:
准备好寻找合适的摄影师了吗？HoneyBook 的摄影师目录让这一过程变得简单。

无论您是在筹办婚礼、订婚派对、生日派对、企业活动还是特别庆典，只需描述您的需求，例如“布鲁克林的婚礼摄影师”或“丹佛附近的订婚摄影师”，即可找到您所在地区值得信赖的摄影服务商。浏览个性化匹配结果、查看他们的作品，并通过 HoneyBook 直接咨询，在几分钟内联系到理想摄影师。

payload.name: Haaretz

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Haaretz is Israel’s oldest daily newspaper, widely respected for its premium journalism and in-depth, analytical reporting. The app allows Haaretz subscribers to link their subscription to their ChatGPT account, enabling them to use ChatGPT models to query the newspaper’s vast and diverse content.
payload.longDescription: Haaretz 是以色列历史最悠久的日报，以高水准新闻报道和深入分析而广受尊重。该应用允许 Haaretz 订阅用户将订阅与 ChatGPT 账号关联，从而使用 ChatGPT 模型查询报纸丰富多样的内容。

payload.name: AutoMotion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use AutoMotion to diagnose, identify, and book needed service for your car, truck, or suv at over 25k automotive locations. AutoMotion displays the nearest oil change, tire, brake, and auto glass shops in your area and can help you schedule an appointment when needed.
payload.longDescription: 使用 AutoMotion 为汽车、卡车或 SUV 诊断、识别所需服务，并在超过 25k 个汽车服务地点预约。AutoMotion 显示你所在地区最近的换油、轮胎、刹车和汽车玻璃服务店，并在需要时帮助你预约。

payload.name: Luma
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whether you're getting into AI or training for a fall marathon, you can find likeminded people on Luma. Join a paper reading or run club to get one step closer to your goals.

Luma powers millions of events around the world. So whether you're into knitting or kiting, you'll be able to find something to join.

If you're hosting an event, you can use this connector to help keep track of and manage your upcoming events.
payload.longDescription:
无论你是想开始了解 AI，还是训练参加秋季马拉松，都可以在 Luma 找到志同道合的人。加入论文阅读会或跑步俱乐部，让自己离目标更近一步。

Luma 为全球数百万场活动提供支持。无论你喜欢编织还是风筝运动，都能找到可以参加的活动。

如果你在主办活动，也可以使用此连接器跟踪和管理即将举行的活动。

payload.name: Dillr
payload.description: 保存食谱、规划餐食并烹饪
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask ChatGPT for a recipe, then actually cook it: Dillr turns it into a step-by-step cook mode with built-in timers and the ingredients one tap away. 

When you find a keeper, save it. Dillr remembers your recipes and your preferences, so every suggestion is relevant to you.

Plan your week in one conversation: real recipes for every meal and a shopping list organized the way you shop, ready to tick off when you're at the store.

Everything you save lives in Dillr, accessible by ChatGPT and in the app when you want it.
payload.longDescription:
向 ChatGPT 索要食谱，然后真正动手烹饪：Dillr 会将食谱转换为逐步烹饪模式，内置计时器，食材信息只需轻点即可查看。

找到喜欢的食谱后就保存下来。Dillr 会记住你的食谱和偏好，因此每条建议都与你相关。

在一段对话中规划一周：为每餐安排真实食谱，并生成按你的购物习惯整理好的购物清单，到店后可逐项勾选。

所有保存内容都存放在 Dillr 中，可由 ChatGPT 访问，也可在你需要时通过应用查看。
